title: The win counter
hook: Two toy policies win at different rates. Is the more frequent winner better on average?

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Compare expected net payoff rather than win frequency alone.

misconception: The policy that wins most often must have the greatest expected net payoff.
objective: Compare expected net payoff rather than win frequency alone.
